territorial_scope.description: Applies to operators that make companion chatbot platforms available to a user in California, including operators located outside the state if they reach California users.

evidence.quote: “Operator” means a person who makes a companion chatbot platform available to a user in the state.

summary.short: Adds Chapter 22.6 on companion chatbot platforms available to users in California, under the Business and Professions Code. Requires operators to give AI disclosures, maintain suicide-prevention protocols, protect known minors, and report annually to the Office of Suicide Prevention from July 1, 2027, with a private right of action.
summary.long: Adds Chapter 22.6 to Division 8 of the Business and Professions Code, regulating operators that make companion chatbot platforms available to users in California. A companion chatbot is an AI system with a natural-language interface that gives adaptive, human-like responses, can meet social needs and sustains relationships across interactions; customer-service bots and limited video-game bots are excluded. Operators must issue a clear and conspicuous notice that a chatbot is artificial and not human where a reasonable person would be misled. They must maintain and publish a protocol against suicidal ideation and self-harm content, including referrals to crisis services, before letting chatbots engage users. For users known to be minors, operators must disclose AI interaction, give default reminders at least every three hours to take a break, and take reasonable measures against sexually explicit visual material. From July 1, 2027, operators must annually report to the Office of Suicide Prevention referral counts and protocols, without personal identifiers. Operators must also disclose that companion chatbots may not be suitable for some minors. Injured persons may sue for injunctive relief, the greater of actual damages or $1,000 per violation, and attorney's fees.

notes: The document contains two identical copies of the enacted text, each under a different AGORA header; it is annotated once. The text gives no chapter, bill or session-law number, so enacted_by_bill is not coded even though the registry status is adopted. 'Operator' is a defined term for a person, not a named entity, so it is not listed under entities. Section 22603(a)(1) refers internally to Section 22602. The relations section is populated in the relations array, so its section_status entry is a required placeholder only.

obligations.summary: Operator must issue a clear and conspicuous notification that the companion chatbot is artificially generated and not human, where a reasonable person would be misled to believe they are interacting with a human.
obligations.conditional_on: A reasonable person interacting with a companion chatbot would be misled to believe the person is interacting with a human

evidence.quote: an operator shall issue a clear and conspicuous notification indicating that the companion chatbot is artificially generated and not human.

obligations.summary: Operator shall prevent a companion chatbot on its platform from engaging with users unless it maintains a protocol for preventing production of suicidal ideation, suicide or self-harm content, including referring users to crisis service providers.

evidence.quote: An operator shall prevent a companion chatbot on its companion chatbot platform from engaging with users unless the operator maintains a protocol

obligations.summary: Operator shall publish details of the suicide and self-harm protocol on its internet website.

evidence.quote: The operator shall publish details on the protocol required by this subdivision on the operator’s internet website.

obligations.summary: For users the operator knows are minors: disclose that the user is interacting with artificial intelligence, and provide by default a notification at least every three hours of continuing interactions reminding the user to take a break and that the chatbot is artificially generated and not human.
obligations.conditional_on: Operator knows the user is a minor

evidence.quote: Disclose to the user that the user is interacting with artificial intelligence.

obligations.summary: For users the operator knows are minors: institute reasonable measures to prevent the companion chatbot from producing visual material of sexually explicit conduct or directly stating that the minor should engage in sexually explicit conduct.
obligations.conditional_on: Operator knows the user is a minor

evidence.quote: Institute reasonable measures to prevent its companion chatbot from producing visual material of sexually explicit conduct

obligations.summary: Operator shall annually report to the Office of Suicide Prevention the number of crisis referral notifications issued in the preceding calendar year, and its protocols to detect, remove and respond to suicidal ideation and to prohibit related chatbot responses.

evidence.quote: Beginning July 1, 2027, an operator shall annually report to the office all of the following:

obligations.summary: The annual report to the Office shall include only the information listed in subdivision (a) and shall not include identifiers or personal information about users.

evidence.quote: shall include only the information listed in subdivision (a) and shall not include any identifiers or personal information about users.

obligations.summary: The Office of Suicide Prevention shall post data from operator reports on its internet website.

evidence.quote: The office shall post data from a report required by this section on its internet website.

obligations.summary: Operator shall use evidence-based methods for measuring suicidal ideation.

evidence.quote: An operator shall use evidence-based methods for measuring suicidal ideation.

obligations.summary: Operator shall disclose to users of its companion chatbot platform, in any format used to access the platform, that companion chatbots may not be suitable for some minors.

evidence.quote: An operator shall disclose to a user of its companion chatbot platform

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff changes scope, eligibility, exemption, obligation tier, prohibition, benefit or penalty tier. The three-hour reminder interval in §22602(c)(2) is a duty parameter, and the $1,000 per-violation figure in §22605(b) is a damages amount (enforcement). The July 1, 2027 date is a deadline event.
